verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents programmatic Person and Business Applications for account opening. Its KYC guide describes plugging a bank-approved third-party KYC/KYB vendor into that flow, plus Incremental KYC without opening an account. Verification itself depends on an external vendor, and the evidence never shows the other parts of the story. Missing for 10: document collection, watchlist/sanctions screening, explicitly modeled application states/status lifecycle, first-party (non-vendor) KYC/KYB execution, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, customer verification is programmatic — KYC for individuals and KYB for businesses with document collection, watchlist screening, and clearly modeled application states

citations.quote: To apply to open a new bank account 1. Create a Person Application 2. Create a Business Application
Programs can seamlessly integrate their bank-approved third-party KYC/KYB vendor into the account opening process.
Incremental KYC lets you run KYC **without opening an account**.
